behaviour: A resin with a pungent, sulphurous smell that mellows in hot fat into something like fried onion and garlic. A tiny amount goes into the fat at the very last moment. The powder in the shops is usually cut with flour.

contains.basis: Ground asafoetida is commonly cut with wheat flour to keep it from lumping.
